reviews.text: Took my daughter here for the first time to check out what creatures the business had and they didn’t disappoint! We had such a fun time chatting with the staff, who were knowledgeable and incredibly friendly. They had a great amount of lizards, large and small, frogs, turtles, spiders, snakes, you name it. You can tell they care for their animals because they talk about their personalities, which is heart warming. If you want an adventure for you and or the kids, check this place out. Highly recommend.

We had an incredible experience at Custom Creatures. My wife had been really interested in learning more about sugar gliders, and the staff went above and beyond to make the experience comfortable and informative for her.
They took the time to patiently answer all of her questions and even allowed her to see and handle a sugar glider before making the decision to buy one. That meant a lot because sugar gliders are unique animals, and getting the chance to interact with one first really helped her feel confident and excited about it.
What stood out the most was how patient and genuine they were. There was no pressure to rush into a purchase, they truly cared about making sure we understood the animal and were comfortable with the decision.
You can tell they have a real passion for the animals they work with and for educating their customers. If you're thinking about getting a sugar glider or any exotic pet, I highly recommend checking out Custom Creatures.

I purchased a white tree frog and a aussie green tree frog on Dec. 27th 2025. i purchased everything from Custom Creatures, the total was over $500.00. I asked the manager several questions on how to take care of the frogs. When i brought them home I tried feeding them and they would not eat. I tried everyday. I went back to the store and talked to the manager to let him know of my concerns. He told me they sometimes take a little while to get use to the change. I purchased some crickets and went home. I continued trying to feed the frogs every day, and they still did not eat. I went back again to speak to the manager and he said to try putting the frogs in water before feeding time or try to put the crickets up the their mouths and irritate the frog with the cricket to kind of force him. I went back home and did what he suggested. Now it has been almost a month and neither frogs have eaten anything. I took one of the frogs to a exotic pet hospital to see if we could find the problem. They prescribed some food that we could force feed them so they would not starve. Since then one of the frogs has died and the other one is still not doing good. I have reached out to the owner of Custom Creatures and let him know exactly what is going on because I would like for the other frog to survive. He is basically keep telling me the frogs were in good health when I purchased them and it has to be my setup. I have sent him pictures and videos of my setup but he can not offer any solutions. He keeps telling me the frogs were healthy when I purchased them. I asked for a refund on the frog cost not the total cost of what I spent at his shop. He said no, the only thing he can do is give me a discount on a new frog. Why would i purchase a new frog if he is saying my set up is incorrect and it is my fault the frogs are dying? Why would I want to bring home new frogs to die? He is not helping me with how to keep the living one alive. Since they never ate not even once. I believe they had to already be sick when I purchased them. He said I can not go off of google or the exotic vet suggestions because they are not accurate, yet he does not tell me what is wrong with my tank or tell me how to properly take care of them. He just keeps telling me they were healthy when I purchased them. How can a business get a way with selling a customer something that is already sick. Do not buy from them, they are very unprofessional and do not take any accountability. I am very said that our frogs only lasted a few months.
